w10_P4_000299: The number a fairground engineer needs, in kN, is the total drive load of 2 identical carousels, each carousel driving 12 identical cars. The load per car, expressed in kN, is the force producing its acceleration plus 28 N of bearing friction. Each car has a mass of 38000 grams and a seat height of 0.6 m. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0. What total drive load, in kN, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000301: A rescue winch pulls a sled of mass 115000 grams up a slipway 30 m long. The sled's acceleration in m/s^2 is 2 times the sum of 6 and 4. The pull producing that acceleration is expressed in kN, and 5 identical sleds are pulled by 5 identical winches at once. The winch frame also carries 5 kN of standing load from its own weight and a further 1 kN from a safety line. What total load, in kN, does the winch frame carry?
w10_P4_000302: The figure a workshop wants, in N, is the total motor output for 11 identical presses, each press having 3 identical rams, each ram's motor supplying the same output. Each ram has a mass of 32 kg, and its acceleration in m/s^2 is 8 times the sum of 7 and 2. The force producing that acceleration is shared: a return spring contributes 23 N and the motor supplies the rest. What total motor output, in N, does the workshop report?
w10_P4_000306: A courier hub has 11 dispatch lanes, and the number of ways of choosing 2 of them, reduced by 7, is used as the speed in m/s of its delivery drones. Each drone has a mass of 40 kg and a rotor span of 1.3 m. A drone's energy of motion at that speed is recorded in kJ. A flight of 10 identical drones has the combined figure, to which the hub adds 15 kJ held in its launch capacitor bank. What total, in kJ, does the hub record?
w10_P4_000307: A rocket sled of mass 189000 grams is tested on a desert rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0, multiplying by 11, and subtracting 26. The rail clamp must carry the force producing that acceleration, plus 12 N of rail friction, plus 26 N from an instrumentation tether. What total load, in N, does the rail clamp carry?
w10_P4_000309: The value an elevator technician wants, in kN, is the net cable load: the combined pull on 10 identical counterweights minus 14 N of relief from a balance spring. Each counterweight has a mass of 55 kg, and each is pulled with the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 14 = 0. What net cable load, in kN, does the technician record?
w10_P4_000314: The figure a bowling-alley engineer wants, in kJ, is the energy budget of a lane: 18 kJ of stored ball-return energy plus the combined energy of motion of 12 identical heavy test balls, expressed in kJ. Each ball has a mass of 36 kg. Each ball's speed in m/s is 2 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0. What energy budget, in kJ, does the engineer record?
w10_P4_000321: The number a factory wants, in N, is the total motor load for 7 identical lines, each line driving 12 identical carts, each cart's motor carrying the same load. The load per motor is the force producing the cart's acceleration, less 11 N supplied by a helper spring, plus 5 N of belt friction. Each cart has a mass of 89000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. What total motor load, in N, does the factory report?
w10_P4_000328: The figure a marina wants, in kN, is the total load on a boat-lift frame: 16 kN of standing load plus the combined pull of 2 identical lifts, each lift carrying 9 identical cradles. The pull on each cradle, expressed in kN, is the force producing its acceleration. Each cradle has a mass of 49 kg. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0. What total load, in kN, does the marina report?
w10_P4_000329: The value a test-track team wants, in J, is the combined energy of motion of 11 identical sleds. Each sled has a mass of 25 kg. The sleds' speed in m/s is set by a calibration rule: take the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 0x between x = 1 and x = 4, add 16, then subtract 27. What combined energy, in J, does the team record?
w10_P4_000335: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is a final tally: an intermediate figure plus 27 kJ from a heater bank plus 1 kJ from a backup cell. The intermediate figure, expressed in kJ, is the energy of motion of a 16 kg trolley minus 26 J lost to friction. The trolley rides a bench 3 m long. Its speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. What final tally, in kJ, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000345: The number a bench technician wants, in N, is the net load on a mounting plate: 3 times the per-bank load, minus 23 N of relief from a counterweight. The per-bank load is the combined push on 10 identical carts minus 19 N supplied by a helper spring. Each cart has a mass of 9 kg and a width of 0.3 m, and the push on each is the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 386 and 395 exactly. What net load, in N, does the technician record?
w10_P4_000346: A robotic pallet shuttle of mass 77 kg runs on a warehouse rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is set by the controller as follows: take the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 3x between x = 0 and x = 2, multiply by 11, then subtract 25, subtract 10 more, and finally subtract 18. The rail is level and frictionless. What force, in N, must the drive supply to produce that acceleration?
w10_P4_000347: The figure a range officer wants, in kJ, is the total energy: 8 kJ held in the launcher's capacitor plus the combined energy of motion of 10 identical salvos, each salvo being 8 identical projectiles. Each projectile has a mass of 39000 grams, and its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. The projectiles' speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 5x between x = 2 and x = 3. What total, in kJ, does the officer record?
w10_P4_000349: The number a lab wants, in kN, is the total mount load: 2 kN of static preload plus the combined drive force on 11 identical sliders, expressed in kN. Each slider has a mass of 15000 grams, and its drive force is the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is 20 less than the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 1x between x = 2 and x = 4. What total mount load, in kN, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000352: A 3000 gram drone flies at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 4x between x = 0 and x = 2. A flight of 8 identical drones has a combined energy of motion, which the operator expresses in kJ. The operator adds 2 kJ for the ground station's battery and then 30 kJ for the charging trailer's reserve. What total, in kJ, does the operator record?
w10_P4_000358: The figure a ski-jump coach wants, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of 5 identical training sleds, each sled's energy expressed in kJ. Each sled has a mass of 21000 grams. The sleds' speed in m/s is found by taking 4 times the sum of 6 and 8, subtracting 13, and then subtracting 1 more. What combined figure, in kJ, does the coach record?
w10_P4_000359: A lab bench launches a 7000 gram puck at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. A tray holds 11 identical pucks, and a rack holds 3 identical trays; the combined energy of motion of a rack, less 24 J absorbed by the rack's foam liner, is the rack's net energy. The bench processes 5 identical racks. What is the total net energy, in J, for the 5 racks?
w10_P4_000360: A parcel conveyor drives totes of mass 39000 grams along a belt 25 m long. Each tote's acceleration in m/s^2 is 5 times the largest whole number that divides both 261 and 367 exactly. The drive on each tote must supply the force producing that acceleration plus 28 N of belt friction. The conveyor drives 6 identical totes at once, and a tensioner relieves 11 N of the combined drive. What net drive force, in N, does the conveyor supply?
w10_P4_000363: A test sled of mass 13000 grams slides along a bench 4 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A logger adds 29 kJ for the bench's stored capacitor energy and then subtracts 17 kJ drawn off by the cooling system. What figure, in kJ, does the logger show?
w10_P4_000364: A pick-and-place robot accelerates a 10000 gram tray along a rail. The tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 5. The rail mount carries the force producing that acceleration, plus 18 N of guide friction, plus 11 N from a cable chain. Express the total mount load in kN.
w10_P4_000368: The figure a lift installer wants, in kN, is the combined motor load of 4 identical hoists, each hoist's motor load expressed in kN. Each hoist raises a car of mass 165 kg through a shaft 40 m tall. The motor load is the force producing the car's acceleration minus 18 N contributed by a balance spring. The car's acceleration in m/s^2 is 8 more than the largest whole number that divides both 137 and 215 exactly. What combined motor load, in kN, does the installer report?
w10_P4_000370: A luggage cart of mass 55000 grams rolls along a concourse 80 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 10x + 24 = 0. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A train of 12 identical carts has the combined figure, from which 6 kJ absorbed by the coupling dampers is subtracted. What net energy, in kJ, remains?
w10_P4_000375: A go-kart of mass 38000 grams runs on a test circuit at a speed in m/s equal to the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 6. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. The pit computer subtracts 25 kJ drawn by the starter, adds 19 kJ recovered by the regenerative brake, and finally adds 30 kJ held in the reserve battery. What figure, in kJ, does the pit computer display?
w10_P4_000377: A bottling plant accelerates crates of mass 73000 grams along a line 18 m long. Each crate's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 2x between x = 1 and x = 3, and each crate is pushed with the force producing that acceleration. A pusher handles 3 crates, a line has 10 identical pushers, and the line's frame also carries 22 N from a tensioning spring on top of the combined push. The plant runs 8 identical lines. What total force, in N, do the frames of all 8 lines carry?
